scope: single-Mother trial for derived JSON used as identity-bearing evidence, cache input, signed receipt or cross-environment regression artifact
trigger: two producers claim the same derived JSON while raw sizes or same-algorithm digests differ, or while only tolerance-based numerical checks are available
assertions: EXACT_BYTES requires the same media type, byte length and same-algorithm digest for both payloads
EXACT_SEMANTIC_OBJECT requires both raw payloads, a pinned canonicalization profile and matching canonical digests
NUMERICAL_EQUIVALENCE requires schema-bound field paths, units, array ordering and explicit tolerances and must not be renamed byte identity
a raw byte mismatch rejects only byte identity unless another claim has its own evidence
missing payloads leave semantic identity and root cause Unknown
canonicalization does not reorder arrays or define domain units and tolerances
digest algorithm identifiers are mandatory and unlike algorithms are not directly comparable
